annotation.title_clean: Enhancing emotion regulation with an in situ socially assistive robot among LGBTQ+ youth with self-harm ideation: protocol for a randomised controlled trial
annotation.title_en: Enhancing emotion regulation with an in situ socially assistive robot among LGBTQ+ youth with self-harm ideation: protocol for a randomised controlled trial
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Williams, A.J.; Cleare, S.; Borschmann, R.; Tench, C.R.; Gross, J.; Hollis, C. et al.
annotation.summary_en: Protocol for a UK single-blind randomised controlled trial testing Purrble, a socially assistive robot, against waitlist control for emotion regulation among 168 LGBTQ+ youth aged 16–25 with self-harm ideation. It includes safeguarding procedures, ethics approval and follow-up interviews. It contains no robot governance provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Single-blind RCT with 168 LGBTQ+ youth, waitlist control, 13 weekly assessments
Primary outcome: emotion dysregulation (DERS-8); secondary: self-harm, anxiety, depression
Purrble robot was codesigned with children and youth; participants keep it after the study
Detailed safeguarding procedure and King's College London ethical approval
Post-deployment interviews explore engagement and appropriation
